title: Chandena13,14,
text: 3 Yam bhikkhave dukkham tatra vo chando pahātabbo || rāgo pahātabbo || chandarāgo pahātabbo || || Kiñca bhikkhave dukkhaṃ || || 4 Rupā bhikkhave dukkhā || tatra vo chando pahātabbo || rāgo pahātabbo || chandarāgo pahātabbo || || 5-8 Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || 9 Dhammā dukkhā tatra vo chando pahātabbo || rāgo pahātabbo || chandarāgo pahātabbo || || 10 Yam bhikkhave dukkhaṃ tatra vo chando pahātabbo || rāgo pahātabbo || chandarāgo pahātabbo ti || || [page 151] XXXV. 173. 3. 9] SAṬṬHI-PEYYĀLAM [VAGGO DUTIYO] 151
